$schema: This bundle's own Claude Code settings -- SEED content, copied once and then yours. The four ai-bridge hooks (SessionStart banner, UserPromptSubmit push-state, and the two PreToolUse enforcement hooks) are NOT registered here any more: they ship with the ai-bridge plugin and fire per machine, so one install arms every bundle instead of only the ones somebody re-stamped. `permissions.deny` stays here because a plugin manifest has no permissions block to carry it, and it is the unconditional second layer behind the deny-destructive hook.
